_about: Public-domain Hugh Stowell (1799-1865), evangelical rector of Christ Church, Salford, hymn writer, for the Word Hoard: The Pleasures of Religion, with other poems (1832), Tractarianism Tested by Holy Scripture (vol. 2, 1845), The Divine Panoply (1846), and the posthumous Sermons Preached in Christ Church, Salford and The Passover and Other Sermons (1869). Hugh Stowell Brown, the Liverpool Baptist, is another man. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 65 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hstowell-pleasures-of-religion: Pleasures of religion : with other poems (London : C.J.G. and F. Rivington [etc.], 1832)

hstowell-salford-sermons: Sermons preached in Christ Church, Salford (London : William Tegg, 1869)
